accounts.name: sandbox4718
accounts.comment: provision failed - AAP2 job not linked

events.stdout: fatal: [localhost]: FAILED! => {"changed": false, "msg": "An error occurred (AddressLimitExceeded) when calling the AllocateAddress operation: The maximum number of addresses has been reached."}
events.error_msg: An error occurred (AddressLimitExceeded) when calling the AllocateAddress operation: The maximum number of addresses has been reached.

answer:
Sandbox account sandbox4718 (AWS account 702918364257) carries the provision GUID wq4ke but no job id. Searching every AAP2 controller for jobs whose name contains wq4ke turns up exactly one: job 66215, "RHPDS agd-v2.rhel-edge-fleet.prod-wq4ke-1-provision", which ran on controller event0.

It did fail: status failed, after about 7.5 minutes (09:14:00 to 09:21:37 UTC on 2026-06-02). The job record itself gives no explanation, so the cause comes from the job's events.

The task that failed was "Allocate the bastion Elastic IP" (role infra_aws_bastion, play "Provision the edge fleet infrastructure", on localhost), right after the VPC and public subnet were created. AWS refused the AllocateAddress call with AddressLimitExceeded: the maximum number of addresses has been reached. In other words the sandbox account was out of Elastic IP quota, so the bastion could not get its public address and the provision stopped there.

To fix it, release unused Elastic IPs in account 702918364257 (or raise its Elastic IP limit) and re-run the provision.
